description: This file contains test fixture code for the MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService, including mock setup, test cases for supported key systems, key system version support, and client connection handling.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleServiceTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService, providing setup and utility methods for unit tests.

methods.name: clientWillConnect
methods.description: Simulates a client connecting to the service, expecting the exportService method to be called.

methods.name: cdmServiceWillGetSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Sets up expectation for the getSupportedKeySystems call to succeed and return predefined key systems.

methods.name: cdmServiceWillSupportsKeySystem
methods.description: Sets up expectation for supportsKeySystem call to succeed for a specific key system.

methods.name: cdmServiceWillGetSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Sets up expectation for getSupportedKeySystemVersion call to succeed and return a version string.

methods.name: cdmServiceWillFailToGetSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Sets up expectation for getSupportedKeySystemVersion call to fail.

methods.name: sendClientConnected
methods.description: Simulates a client connection to the service.

methods.name: sendGetSupportedKeySystemsRequestAndReceiveResponse
methods.description: Sends a request to get supported key systems and verifies the response matches expectations.

methods.name: sendSupportsKeySystemRequestAndReceiveResponse
methods.description: Sends a supportsKeySystem request and verifies the response.

methods.name: sendGetSupportedKeySystemVersionRequestAndReceiveResponse
methods.description: Sends a request for key system version and verifies the response.

methods.name: sendGetSupportedKeySystemVersionRequestAndExpectFailure
methods.description: Sends a version request expecting failure and verifies the response is empty.

methods.name: expectRequestSuccess
methods.description: Sets expectation that the closure's Run method will be called, indicating success.

methods.name: expectRequestFailure
methods.description: Sets expectation that the controller's SetFailed method and closure's Run method will be called, indicating failure.
